rdfs:label: Public
rdfs:comment: The special ActivityPub addressee IRI https://www.w3.org/ns/activitystreams#Public — an implicit Collection instance meaning "everyone", not a class. Put it in as:to / as:cc to make an object publicly visible; never use it as an @type.
notes: as:Public is an individual IRI (a special collection used as an addressee), not a class; it is typed rdfs:Class here only because the registry schema admits rdfs:Class / rdf:Property. The single most-referenced IRI on the fediverse: used as a value of `as:to` or `as:cc` to mark a post as public; absence of it means the post is non-public regardless of other audience settings. On the wire always emit the full IRI `https://www.w3.org/ns/activitystreams#Public` (Mastodon and most servers also accept `as:Public` / `Public` inside an AS2 @context) — ActivityPub servers only recognise that exact IRI, never the urn:solid:Public alias.

history.note: Clarified that as:Public is an addressee IRI, not a class; example now addresses the full AS Public IRI; notes warn the urn:solid alias is not recognised by servers.
